name: Cardboard, corrugated kraft paperboard
source: Composition (per kg): water 70 g, mineral filler/coating (ash) 30 g, cellulosic fibre by difference 900 g, typical of corrugated kraft paperboard (pulp and paper industry proximate figures).
notes: The cellulosic fibre (cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin) is modelled with the generic starch/cellulose elemental profile (C44.4/H6.2/O49.4 %, as (C6H10O5)n), which is a reasonable approximation for a lignocellulosic material. Half the mineral filler, calcium carbonate used for coating and sizing, is assigned to Ca; the rest (kaolin clay and other untracked fillers) is carried by Ash so the kilogram closes exactly.
